"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for legislation requiring financial responsibility for a child to be equally borne by both the mother and father upon conception until the child reaches adulthood.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Failure to require a father to be equally responsible for a child places an inequitable burden on the mother, creating a financial and social hardship on both mother and child.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Celebration of millions of Americans who open their hearts, homes, and churches to mothers in need and women fleeing abuse.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Thanks and encouragement to providers of counseling, medical services, and adoption assistance for empowering women experiencing an unintended pregnancy to choose life.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for funding for ultrasounds and adoption assistance.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Salute to states that protect women and girls through laws requiring informed consent, parental consent, waiting periods, and clinic regulation.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Condemnation of the Supreme Court's decision in Whole Woman's Health v. Hellerstedt striking down Texas laws providing for basic health and safety standards in abortion clinics.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
